sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, SUM(CASE WHEN s.account_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_rows FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_hash FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account GROUP BY account_hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT vendor_id) > 1) s ON s.account_hash = b.account_hash LIMIT 1
